title: Diffusion LLM (LLaDA / Mercury Coder / Block Diffusion) vs. Autoregressive LLM Selection: Breaking the Serial HBM Bandwidth Wall

workload_basis.task: 512-Token Code / Structured JSON / Whole-File Edit Generation
workload_basis.hardware: Single NVIDIA H100 80GB (3.35 TB/s HBM, 989 TFLOPS FP16)

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Standard Serial Autoregressive Decode (1 Token/Step, Memory-Bandwidth-Bound)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Sequential token-by-token chat streaming & open-ended long narratives

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Autoregressive + Speculative Decoding (EAGLE-3 / MTP Draft K=4)
tiers.recommended_scenario: General-purpose AR latency acceleration while preserving causal ordering

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Vanilla Full-Sequence Masked Diffusion LLM (LLaDA Without Prefix KV Cache)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Short-prompt whole-block infilling, reversal curse tasks & fixed-length generation

tiers.tier: Tier 4 (Recommended): Semi-Autoregressive Block Diffusion (BD3-LM / Mercury Style) + Prefix KV Cache + Confidence Unmasking
tiers.recommended_scenario: Ultra-fast IDE whole-file code edits, JSON generation & sub-second agent action blocks (8.9x faster)
